title.zh: Ostium Recovery Plan Repays 3,321 Wallets In Full, Leaves 345 To Choose
title.en: Ostium Recovery Plan Repays 3,321 Wallets In Full, Leaves 345 To Choose

current_state.zh: Ostium's recovery plan fully repays 3,321 wallets with losses of $1,000 or less, while 345 wallets carrying at least 86% of the $23.8 million loss must choose between a $1,000 payment and a pro-rata claim on still-unrecovered funds.
